content.rendered:
Bond insulated coffee mug with suction 500ML

Slightly visible orange suction base, designed to prevent accidental tipping

The Bond travel coffee mug blends premium quality, innovative design and everyday convenience. Built with double-wall insulation and a stainless steel inner layer, it keeps beverages hot or cold for longer while maintaining a fresh, clean taste. Its durable outer shell gives a modern look that’s also scratch resistant and easy to clean.

The highlight of this mug is its advanced suction base, engineered to anchor securely to smooth, flat surfaces — dramatically reducing the chance of spills and accidental tipping at desks, kitchen counters or while on the move. Despite the firm hold, it releases effortlessly when lifted vertically, making it hassle-free to use.

With its generous 500 ml capacity, ergonomic shape and sleek design, the Bond Insulated Suction Mug is perfect for daily use and travel alike. Its stylish, functional build makes it an excellent choice for corporate gifts, promotional campaigns, or festive giveaways, especially when customized with your brand logo or message.

Whether at home, at work, or on the go, this coffee tumbler offers the ideal combination of temperature retention, spill-resistance and modern aesthetics — a thoughtful, practical premium your recipients will appreciate and use every day.
